[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Jaya Bluffs northwestern camp.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Camp in the northwestern corner | pic3 = [[Image:Jaya Bluffs overlooking the northern harbor.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = A harbor town seen from [[Zuuyun Point]] | pic4 = [[Image:Jaya Bluffs overlooking the northeastern village.jpg|196px]] | pic4-text = A village seen from [[Kaanai Caverns]] | ingame name=Jaya Bluffs | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=196 }} [[Jaya Bluffs]] is the name given to the eastern half of [[Shing Jea Island]]'s central mountain range. The bluffs are comprised of snow-covered mountains and inhabited by the warring [[Yeti]] and [[Sensali]] [[Tengu]]. Jaya Bluffs also overlooks the beaches on the northern side of the island, and settlements can be seen along the beach. A small encampment of Canthans are also found in the northwestern corner; what they are doing there is not known. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== Exit from [[Seitung Harbor]] located North in the Outpost or travel west through [[Haiju Lagoon]] from [[Zen Daijun (outpost)|Zen Daijun]]. The [[primary quest]] [[Looking For Trouble]] will lead [[Factions]] characters here. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] **South, at the exit into [[Seitung Harbor]]. *[[Lyssa's Muse]] **Northeast, at the exit into [[Haiju Lagoon]], inside [[Kaanai Caverns]]. *[[Voice of Grenth]] **North, short distance northwest from [[Miki Lake]]. ==Quests available== :''(these quests are only available to [[Factions]] characters)'' *[[Gull Hookbeak]] **[[The Rite of Valor]] *[[Yorrt Strongjaw]] **[[Death with Honor]] *[[Zho]] **[[To the Rescue (Factions quest)|To the Rescue]] {{quest icon|primary}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{w}} 15 (20) [[Gruut Snowfoot]] ([[collector]] for 3 [[Feathered Crest]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Morokam]] (collector for 3 [[Stolen Supplies]]) *{{x}} 20 (20) [[Rei Ming]] (collector for 3 [[Silver Crimson Skull Coin]]s) ====Other allies==== *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Canthan Guard]]s (in the northwestern corner) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Canthan Peasant]]s (in the northwestern corner) ===Charmable animals=== *{{x}} 3 [[Tiger]] (found near the northwestern corner, near [[Zuuyun Point]], and near the southeastern corner) ===Foes=== [[Demon]]s *[[Oni]] **{{a}} 16 (25) [[Oni]] (three hidden - southwest from [[Rei Ming]], southwest of [[Sizhou Hall]], and south of [[Morokam]]) [[Tengu]] *[[Sensali]] **{{w}} 12 (24) [[Sensali Cutter]] **{{n}} 12 (24) [[Sensali DarkFeather]] **{{a}} 12 (24) [[Sensali Claw]] [[Yeti]] *{{w}} 15 (25) [[Mountain Yeti]] *{{mo}} 13 (24) [[Longhair Yeti]] *{{n}} 12 (24) [[Red Yeti]] ====Bosses==== [[Yeti]] *{{w}} 13 (27) [[Hanjuu Towerfist]] ([[Hanjuu's Bludgeoner]]) *{{r}} 13 (27) [[Ahvha Sankii]] ([[Ahvha's Longbow]]) *{{e}} 13 (27) [[Sanhan Tall Earth]] ([[Sanhan's Staff]]) ==Points of interest== *[[Kaanai Caverns]] *[[Miki Lake]] *[[Sizhou Hall]] *[[Zuuyun Point]] ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *These quests will affect the spawns in this area: **[[Death with Honor]], [[Looking For Trouble]] and [[The Rite of Valor]]. *This area is a popular choice for [[Guide to feather farming|Feather farming]]. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. **When mapping, there is a small path in the top NW area, where one of the main Factions quests leads to, that may be missed. *{{Vanquisher|count = 195|low = 163|high = 202}} **The [[Yeti]] and the [[Sensali]] [[Tengu]]s are hostile to each other.
